indexes.name: alerts_active_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX alerts_active_idx ON public.alerts USING btree (device_id, status) WHERE (status = 'active'::alert_status)

indexes.name: alerts_device_triggered_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX alerts_device_triggered_idx ON public.alerts USING btree (device_id, triggered_at DESC)

indexes.name: alerts_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX alerts_pkey ON public.alerts USING btree (id)

indexes.name: devices_device_code_unique_idx

indexes.name: devices_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX devices_pkey ON public.devices USING btree (id)

indexes.name: devices_serial_number_unique_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX devices_serial_number_unique_idx ON public.devices USING btree (serial_number) WHERE (serial_number IS NOT NULL)

triggers.name: devices_updated_at
triggers.events: CREATE TRIGGER devices_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.devices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

user_devices.description: Many-to-many relationship between users and TAGANA devices.
